notes:
Summary: Stalled -> Closed-Lost. Nautilus ran a 6-week POC (reranking + tool-calling + structured output). Initial interest high (reducing unit cost, private deployment). Outcome: chose incumbent due to reliability of structured outputs and tool-call consistency.

Key quote: CTO Jason Lee - 'We can't risk malformed tool outputs in production; our workflows call external trading services and the JSON must be strict.'
CISO Priya Rao - 'Need ISO27001 + on-prem KMS + audit trails or we stop here.'

POC feedback (technical):
- Observed intermittent quality regression vs incumbent on multi-step tool-calls (Redwood variant produced missing fields or invalid JSON ~8-12% on sample prompts).
- Reranker embeddings precision slightly lower for legal/financial docs (relevance drop noticed in eval set).
- Function/tool-calling behavior inconsistent with schema enforcement; required extra app-side validation and filtering.
- Latency within SLO for small loads, but burst profile unclear for peak batch windows.

Commercial / org notes:
- Procurement requested revised pricing for dedicated capacity; we quoted $350k ARR commit.
- Budget freeze announced by CFO 2026-02-14 (hiring freeze and vendor consolidation) — buy window closed.
- Product lead (internal champion) left in January, created adoption gap and slowed exec sponsorship.

Security: Redwood shared SOC2 report and KMS integration doc. Nautilus flagged missing ISO27001 certificate and required on-prem key control/hsm. They asked for a signed security SLA and encryption-in-use guarantees; engineering recommended air-gapped option but procurement was unwilling to fund additional integration.

Competitive notes: Anthropic demoed better schema-adherent tool outputs in sprint demo; incumbent (OpenAI) has an existing enterprise contract and proved more predictable on function-calling in their benchmarks — procurement defaulted to incumbent to avoid rework.

Next steps attempted: final exec deck on 2026-02-18 (drive link), post-mortem call 2026-02-25. Outcome: closed-lost to incumbent. Action: document lessons, add improved schema validation tests to future POC kits, and re-open in next budget cycle.
